name: Occidental-Armillary
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by an ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls solar potential controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
